mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.5% signals economic weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows unemployment above 4.5% correlates with negative equity returns
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Consumer Spending and Equity Market Correlation
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Inflation and industrial production have inverse relationship
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A high employment level (PAYEMS > 145,000 thousand) reflects strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 145,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 3.0% indicates persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:GDP and housing are leading indicators
failure_condition: The joint increase in GDPC1 and HOUST does not yield positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, reducing liquidity and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Monetary Policy Tightening and Equity Markets
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.
